senses.gloss: n. gent. m. Asmonean, Hasmonean, family name of Mattathias the priest and his descendants (Maccabean dynasty).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:6">Midd. I, 6</cite> <he>בני ח׳</he> the sons of the Asmonean (Judah and his brothers).
<cite ref="Shabbat 21b:10">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>מלכות בית ח׳</he> the government of the Asmonean house.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 93:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIII</cite>, beg. (ed. Bub. plur.).
Sot. 49ᵇ; Men. 64ᵇ; B. Kam. 82ᵇ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) מלכי בית the kings of the Asmonean house (Hyrcan and Aristobulus).—Pl. חַשְׁמוֹנָאִים. B. Kam. l. c. (some ed.).—[Chald.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 2:4">Targ. I Sam. II, 4</cite>.
